init.title: Kia Access options
init.description: By default every update reads Kia's server-side cache, which is gentle on the car's 12V battery. Turn on 'Poll the car directly' only if you need up-to-the-minute data — it wakes the vehicle on every poll and can flatten the 12V battery if the car is parked for long periods.

data.poll_car_directly: Poll the car directly (wakes the vehicle — drains the 12V battery)
data.force_refresh_timeout: Live wake-up wait (seconds) — only used when polling directly
data.price_per_kwh: Price per kWh (your all-in marginal rate, 0 = no cost tracking)
data.range_factor: Range reach factor (haircut on the car's range estimate)
data.range_reserve_pct: Range reach reserve % (arrive with this much charge left)
data.calendar_entities: Calendar entities for trip destinations (comma-separated, e.g. calendar.work, calendar.family)
data.static_destinations: Fixed destinations (one per line: Name | address)
data.zone_entities: Zones to show (blank = all US zones)

data_description.poll_car_directly: Off (recommended): data comes from Kia's servers — refreshed whenever the car itself checks in (driving, charging, app use). On: each poll wakes the car for a live reading.
data_description.force_refresh_timeout: How long to wait for the car to answer before falling back to the cached copy for that poll.
data_description.calendar_entities: Events with a location on these calendars are geocoded and added to the reachable-destinations list / range-map pins. US locations only.
data_description.drive_time_provider: Estimate (default) uses straight-line distance. Geoapify or TomTom return real road distance and live-traffic drive time via one matrix call per poll (free tiers are plenty; needs the matching API key).
data_description.routing_api_key: Used for live drive times AND for geocoding calendar event locations. A Geoapify key works for both even if the drive-time provider is left on “estimate” (Nominatim increasingly blocks Home Assistant).
data_description.drive_time_routes: TomTom only: one routing call per destination each refresh so the reachable list can show “via <roads>” and colour the ETA by traffic delay. Turn off for one cheap matrix call (time + distance only).
data_description.static_destinations: Always-shown destinations for the reachable list / driving-times panel, one per line as "Name | address" — e.g. "White House | 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC". Geocoded once and cached.
data_description.geocoding_api_key: A Geoapify key used only to turn calendar / static addresses into coordinates. Set this if your routing provider is TomTom (TomTom's Search API is not on every key) or you left the provider on “estimate”.
data_description.zone_entities: Limit which Home Assistant zones appear in the reachable / driving-times list. One per line, by entity id or name (e.g. “zone.home” or “Work”). A line starting with “-” excludes that zone instead. Blank = every US zone.
